India and Poland Boost Cooperation in Defence, AI, and Critical Minerals

Prime Minister Narendra Modi held discussions with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk to explore new areas of cooperation between India and Poland. The talks focused on strengthening ties in defence, artificial intelligence (AI), and critical minerals. Both leaders also discussed expanding cooperation in space and nuclear energy. Polish Prime Minister Tusk stated that India and Poland have no conflicts of interest and referred to Prime Minister Modi as a 'beacon of hope'. The discussions aimed to chart a new course for their strategic partnership.
